answer: To earn trust, participants wander through rotating witness pools, and only those reaching a verification summit with a clear crystal record of unique attestations gain voting weight. One concrete sybil-resistance mechanism is a staked proof-of-personhood gate where each agent must lock a bond and complete a random peer-verification round. Attackers must fund many bonded identities and pass live peer checks, making mass sybil creation costly and easily slashed. From qwe0005's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
